title: Window Sign (Read from the Street)
summary: A neon marquee your eye reads forward and every machine reads backward — the back of the glass.
mechanism: CSS unicode-bidi:bidi-override + direction:rtl renders a DOM string stored in reverse, so render, clipboard, Find-in-page and screen readers diverge.
references: Bruce Nauman, neon window/spiral signs incl. The True Artist Helps the World by Revealing Mystic Truths (1967)
